title: DESNZ average annual domestic standard electricity bills
publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
publication: Annual domestic energy bills, Table QEP 2.2.5
bill_basis: Average standard-electricity bill paid across payment methods and tariffs; inclusive of VAT; cash terms
comparison_method: The notebook linearly interpolates between the published 3,400 and 3,600 kWh values to give a 3,100 kWh indicative cross-check. It must not be presented as a price-cap validation because the DESNZ series is a UK average bill, while the model benchmark is a GB Direct-Debit price-cap allowance.
